svg.text: What 41 SaaS Pricing Ladders Are Named
Counted from 41 usable ladders captured on 7 September 2026 from 52 pricing pages

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: ladders use the word Enterprise somewhere
31 of them use Enterprise as an exact label.

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: free rungs are labeled exactly Free. The
other eleven use nine different labels.
Hobby, Starter, Personal, Individual, Developer and four more.

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: seat-priced ladders run exactly four rungs.
The full range is three rungs to eight.
Box is the widest at eight rungs.

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: ladders with a confirmed order hide the top
Nine publish a number on the top rung.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Two low-confidence pages excluded. Four usage-priced pages excluded from the rung count.
